names.legendary: Doughmorian, Keeper of the First Rise

lore.common: Lives in the bread bin and pretends nobody can hear it nibbling its own crust.
lore.uncommon: Keeps the two end slices for itself. The rest of the loaf has never forgiven this.
lore.rare: Rises again whenever the baker says it's finished. The bread tin now needs a second floor.
lore.epic: Expanded across the entire village bakery overnight. By morning every street had its own crust and the mayor declared a toast emergency.
lore.legendary: Doughmorian baked the first loaf from a handful of starlight and a very impatient yeast. Every oven still warms when it dreams of that bread.

names.legendary: Signor Pressolino, Knight of the Melt

lore.common: Wears toasted grill marks like medals and demands to be admired from both sides.
lore.uncommon: Oozes cheese onto the napkin every time its owner looks away.
lore.rare: Can stretch a single cheese strand across the entire cafe, trapping fleeing customers by their shoelaces.
lore.epic: Escaped the sandwich press and rolled through the lunchtime rush, collecting fillings from every table. The chef has named it the all-inclusive special.
lore.legendary: Signor Pressolino melted the heart of a bitter giant with one perfectly toasted sandwich. The giant wept mozzarella for a week and opened the first mountain cafe.

names.legendary: Picnicus, Devourer of the Entire Picnic

lore.common: Gives up its filling after a single enthusiastic bite, then blames gravity.
lore.uncommon: Smuggles the last slice of cheese out of the lunchbox and leaves a trail of crumbs.
lore.rare: Swaps its filling with another sandwich in the bag. The ham-and-jam combination is not popular.
lore.epic: Grew so enormous at a picnic that the family had to crawl through its soft centre to retrieve the mustard. The ants set up a tollbooth.
lore.legendary: Picnicus swallowed the blanket, the basket and every sandwich at a legendary summer feast. When cut in half, it revealed an entire park with another picnic already underway.

names.legendary: Gateauzar, Lord of the Everlasting Feast

lore.common: Eats its own icing whenever nobody watches. The baker blames the children.
lore.uncommon: Sinks in the middle to lure hungry guests close, then sneezes powdered sugar in their faces.
lore.rare: Sings Happy Birthday to whoever cuts the first slice, regardless of the occasion. Funerals have become awkward.
lore.epic: Rose through the bakery roof in seven glorious tiers and declared the top floor an independent nation of sprinkles.
lore.legendary: Each layer of Gateauzar marks an age of civilisation. At the bottom lies the first birthday ever celebrated, and somewhere near the top is a very angry candle.

names.legendary: Candelor, Thief of Unspoken Wishes

lore.common: Stands on a cake for five minutes and calls itself the guest of honour.
lore.uncommon: Drips hot wax directly onto the letter in the icing that matters most.
lore.rare: Relights itself whenever someone wishes for more cake. The bakery fears it.
lore.epic: One birthday puff blew a wish clean out of the house. It granted the family cat a sports car and refused to discuss the paperwork.
lore.legendary: Keeps every wish ever whispered over a cake in a tiny flame. One day it may grant them all, but first it wants everyone to sing properly.

names.legendary: Popalina, Celestial Queen of Crumbs

lore.common: Loses its head on the first bite. The stick acts as if nothing happened.
lore.uncommon: Sheds sprinkles like dandruff, leaving a suspiciously festive trail to the snack cupboard.
lore.rare: Can launch itself from its stick and orbit a birthday cake until somebody catches it.
lore.epic: Turned a children's party into a miniature meteor shower of chocolate and icing. The dog considered it a miracle.
lore.legendary: Popalina escaped a baker's tray and took her place among the stars. When she twinkles, every birthday wish smells faintly of vanilla.

names.legendary: Sweetmageddon, the Last Forbidden Treat

lore.common: Crinkles its wrapper loudest during quiet moments in the cinema. It lives for the shushing.
lore.uncommon: Twists itself into a knot no human fingers can untie. The candy inside has already escaped.
lore.rare: Turns everyone who eats it into a squeaky-voiced philosopher for one minute. Their conclusions are mostly about more candy.
lore.epic: Burst from a festival pinata as a technicolour hailstorm. The mayor called it a weather event and issued free dental appointments.
lore.legendary: Sweetmageddon appears once every century inside an unmarked wrapper. Those who taste it remember every sweet they ever ate and immediately demand another.

names.legendary: Caramordia, Queen of the Golden Trap

lore.common: Refuses to leave its wrapper without taking half the paper along for the ride.
lore.uncommon: Glues two teeth together and enjoys the silence that follows. Dentists call it job security.
lore.rare: Stretching from one bite to the next, its golden thread has been spotted across three streets.
lore.epic: Covered the royal ballroom in molten caramel and forced every dancer into a slow-motion waltz. Nobody wanted to be first to leave.
lore.legendary: Caramordia spun sunlight into the first sticky sweet and trapped a thunderbolt inside. A single bite tastes of summer and takes a decade to chew.

names.legendary: Bubblord, Lord of the Infinite Pop

lore.common: Loses its flavour after one minute but clings to your molars for another three hours.
lore.uncommon: Waits on the pavement for a freshly cleaned shoe. It can smell new trainers.
lore.rare: Inflates itself into a perfect bubble whenever someone is about to say something important.
lore.epic: Blew a bubble that engulfed the entire school assembly. The headteacher addressed the children through a wall of strawberry-scented pink.
lore.legendary: Bubblord has chewed through seven centuries without losing his flavour. Legend says the last bubble he blows will hold a whole kingdom; he is still deciding which flavour it should be.

names.legendary: Gummbert, the Unchewable Wanderer

lore.common: Sticks to the bottom of a sweet bag and demands to be rescued by someone with clean fingers.
lore.uncommon: Wobbles in such convincing dance moves that the other sweets have started selling tickets.
lore.rare: Bounces out of every hand that tries to eat it, then hides beneath the sofa like a very sticky rabbit.
lore.epic: Grew into a jelly bear taller than the sweetshop and ate its own display sign. The shopkeeper charged admission instead.
lore.legendary: Gummbert escaped the first sweetmaker's mould and has wandered the land ever since. Children leave sugar crystals on windowsills in case he visits.

names.legendary: Beanoracle, Teller of Impossible Tastes

lore.common: Hides the worst flavour at the bottom of the bag and watches everyone argue about it.
lore.uncommon: Looks like strawberry but tastes suspiciously of sprouts.
lore.rare: Switches flavour halfway through a bite, turning chocolate into pickle just as someone says delicious.
lore.epic: Burst across the school hall in a rainbow stampede. Every teacher skidded out of assembly carrying a different flavour.
lore.legendary: Beanoracle holds a flavour for every memory in the world. The sweetest recalls your happiest birthday; the strangest tastes like the day you first learned to ride a bicycle.

names.legendary: Inkatongue, Serpent of the Sweet Night

lore.common: Turns the eater's tongue black and watches them try to explain it at dinner.
lore.uncommon: Winds itself into an impossible knot, then dares anyone to untangle a snack.
lore.rare: Can slither out of its packet, tie itself to a chair and drag the sweets cupboard into the hallway.
lore.epic: Became the skipping rope at school break and shrank with every jump because somebody kept taking a bite. By lunchtime the whole class had black tongues.
lore.legendary: Inkatongue is a serpent woven from the first dark liquorice root. It winds through midnight sweetshops, leaving a trail of ink-black twists and a mystery no dentist can solve.

names.legendary: Lord Lollivortex, the Endless Sweet

lore.common: Lures children with bright stripes, then glues itself to the wrapper.
lore.uncommon: Falls onto the fairground grass and returns wearing a full coat of mysterious fluff.
lore.rare: Spins its rainbow coils until everyone in the queue forgets which ride they were waiting for.
lore.epic: Hypnotised the entire carousel with a single slow turn. The wooden horses demanded a second lap without their riders.
lore.legendary: Lord Lollivortex contains a different childhood summer in every coloured ring. Take one lick and hear a fairground that vanished a thousand years ago.

names.legendary: Peppermorta, the Winter Between Teeth

lore.common: Climbs onto the tongue and blows a tiny winter breeze into every conversation.
lore.uncommon: Appears at the end of a fancy meal whether anybody invited it. Has very strong opinions about garlic.
lore.rare: Steals the S from every sentence and turns it into a whistle. The choir has requested a different dessert.
lore.epic: One mint after the banquet chilled every noble's breath into visible snowflakes. The royal chandeliers grew icicles and the soup needed reheating.
lore.legendary: Peppermorta cracked once beneath a giant's teeth and froze the sound of the crunch in mid-air. Travellers still hear it chiming above the mountain pass each winter.

names.legendary: Lord Taffragon, the Unchewable Relic

lore.common: Grabs a molar and refuses to let go until someone offers it more sugar.
lore.uncommon: Has become one with its wrapper and regards the paper as a fashionable coat.
lore.rare: Hardens into a tiny amber statue whenever someone bites it; the dentist has started a museum.
lore.epic: Turned a village sweet shop into a fortress of molten caramel that trapped every spoon within a hundred metres.
lore.legendary: Lord Taffragon was made by a confectioner who challenged a mountain to a chewing contest. The mountain lost three peaks and the toffee still has its original shape.

names.legendary: Truffelina, the Last Bite of Midnight

lore.common: Melts on the fingers long before it reaches the mouth.
lore.uncommon: Hides a surprising filling behind a very innocent cocoa-dusted face.
lore.rare: Disappears from a chocolate box whenever someone offers to share it, then reappears in the selfish person's pocket.
lore.epic: Grew into a rich dark chocolate mountain in the middle of a banquet. The guests needed climbing ropes and miniature dessert spoons.
lore.legendary: Truffelina was shaped from the first secret recipe ever whispered between bakers. A single taste can make someone remember the happiest meal they forgot they had eaten.

names.legendary: Brownora, the Bottomless Chocolate Abyss

lore.common: Has a crackly top and a soft centre. It keeps the corner pieces for itself.
lore.uncommon: Pretends not to be ready whenever someone opens the oven. Its middle is an accomplished liar.
lore.rare: Grows four extra crispy corners every time somebody cuts a piece. The middle is almost extinct.
lore.epic: Melted into a chocolate river through the school bake sale. The pupils built a bridge out of marshmallows and charged a toll.
lore.legendary: Deep inside Brownora's warm centre lies a hidden kingdom of cocoa and lost spoons. Its queen has never seen the surface and refuses to share the recipe.

names.legendary: Chocolath, Keeper of the Last Cocoa Bean

lore.common: Melts in your pocket on the hottest possible day, regardless of the weather.
lore.uncommon: Breaks exactly one square short of the portion you wanted. Has done the mathematics.
lore.rare: One bite can erase a week of misery from an entire room. The office accountant denies knowing what happiness is but keeps asking for another square.
lore.epic: Rose from the confectionery factory as a molten chocolate giant. The emergency services arrived with spoons.
lore.legendary: Chocolath guards the last cocoa bean from a vanished civilisation. Anyone who tastes its dark treasure remembers every sweet moment of their life, plus that embarrassing thing from school.

names.legendary: Fudgathor, Lord of the Sticky Sea

lore.common: Crumbles at the slightest touch, then sticks to every finger attempting the rescue.
lore.uncommon: Pretends to be a neat square until somebody tries to pick it up.
lore.rare: Steals the sugar from nearby biscuits and leaves them tasting of disappointment.
lore.epic: A slab of fudge melted across the harbour and held every boat in place for a week. The sailors called it a very sweet blockade.
lore.legendary: Fudgathor once turned a raging sea into caramel and walked across it without sinking. His footsteps are still sold in little souvenir boxes.

names.legendary: Sir Crumbleton, Eater of the Last One

lore.common: Drops crumbs exactly where someone just vacuumed.
lore.uncommon: Dives into milk, then refuses to come back up until rescue biscuits arrive.
lore.rare: Steals chocolate chips from other cookies and displays them like stolen medals.
lore.epic: Crumbled across a royal banquet so spectacularly that an entire army of pigeons stormed the dining hall.
lore.legendary: Defeated the great Famine of Midnight with a single impossible chocolate chip. Its one weakness is someone saying they are only having half.

names.legendary: Crustadamus, the Inedible Truth

lore.common: Rattles its little paper prophecy like a magician hiding a card up its sleeve. Knows nothing about the future.
lore.uncommon: Predicts the future in strangely specific fortunes: Beware a Tuesday with too many pigeons.
lore.rare: Every prediction comes true, but in the most inconvenient possible way. Its winning lottery ticket was for a raffle of socks.
lore.epic: At the emperor's feast, each cookie predicted the next course. When the final one read RUN, the dessert began chasing the guests.
lore.legendary: Crustadamus knows exactly when the universe will end. It keeps that prophecy hidden in a cookie nobody can open without breaking a tooth.

names.legendary: Gingerbolt, Who Outran the Story

lore.common: Smiles through a row of icing buttons and watches the oven door like a prisoner studying the guard.
lore.uncommon: Has two icing buttons and the determined expression of someone planning a prison break.
lore.rare: Drops crumbs to confuse anyone chasing it. The pigeons are excellent trackers.
lore.epic: Escaped the oven with the entire biscuit tray. The baker found a handwritten note: CATCH US IF YOU CAN.
lore.legendary: Gingerbolt ran past the fox, the river and the end of the fairy tale. Somewhere beyond the last page he is still sprinting, pursued by a very tired narrator.

names.legendary: Marquise Macarielle of Seven Colours

lore.common: Looks too delicate to eat, then explodes into crumbs the moment anyone tries.
lore.uncommon: Insists its filling is a royal secret. It is mostly raspberry.
lore.rare: Shatters at the sound of the word 'crunch', leaving a cloud of almond dust and an insulted pastry chef.
lore.epic: Reordered the patisserie's rainbow display overnight. Customers began speaking in colours and ordering 'a little more turquoise'.
lore.legendary: Marquise Macarielle once baked seven seasons into seven fragile shells. Break the golden one and the first spring morning returns for a single heartbeat.

names.legendary: Vanillara, Star of the Oven Sky

lore.common: Drops a rainbow sprinkle into every sock it meets.
lore.uncommon: Swaps its iced smile for a suspicious wink when the baker turns away.
lore.rare: Changes the faces on decorated cookies so the birthday guests can never agree which one to eat.
lore.epic: Sprouted enormous icing wings and flew around the bakery, dive-bombing customers with edible stars.
lore.legendary: Vanillara was baked in the shape of the first star. On winter nights it guides lost travellers by a warm vanilla scent no wind can scatter.

names.legendary: Waforia, the Thousandfold Sweet

lore.common: Drops a tiny shower of crumbs at the first suspicious glance.
lore.uncommon: Hides one extra cream layer that only appears after a sneeze.
lore.rare: Plays a different musical note on each crisp layer when tapped.
lore.epic: Split into a million crunchy sheets and rebuilt itself as a snack-sized castle. The birthday children immediately declared war on the chocolate moat.
lore.legendary: Once stacked layers thin enough to separate a thousand sunsets. When the last wafer was eaten, the sky briefly tasted of vanilla.

names.legendary: Croissantus, Moon of a Thousand Layers

lore.common: Sheds fifty flakes on clean clothes before anyone takes a bite.
lore.uncommon: Leaves a butter stain exactly the shape of a tiny French flag.
lore.rare: Escapes the bakery in the shape of a golden moon, pursued by hungry pigeons.
lore.epic: Unfolded its layers across Paris like a pastry tidal wave. The baker called it a disaster; the tourists called it breakfast.
lore.legendary: Was baked from a sliver of the moon stolen by a celestial chef. Every dawn it rises golden and vanishes by lunch, leaving crumbs in the constellations.

names.legendary: Cupcarnyx, Throne of a Thousand Swirls

lore.common: Has more frosting than actual cake. Insists the proportions are sacred.
lore.uncommon: Steals one sprinkle from every birthday hat it passes.
lore.rare: Sneezes clouds of coloured sugar that turn everyone into walking party decorations.
lore.epic: Rose from the party table as a towering frosting colossus. The guests fled; the children followed with spoons.
lore.legendary: Its icing spirals reach beyond the clouds, where the gods gather to steal a lick. The last god caught cheating had to wash the entire celestial baking tray.

names.legendary: Doughmageddon, Lord of the Empty Centre

lore.common: Leaves a trail of sugar wherever it rolls. The ants treat it as a royal road.
lore.uncommon: Bites back when somebody squeezes it too hard, spraying jam with impressive accuracy.
lore.rare: Stares through its own hole into another bakery. Nobody knows where the stolen sprinkles go.
lore.epic: Rolled into the mayor's parade as a giant glazed wheel and converted the entire route into a sticky racetrack.
lore.legendary: An ancient baker punched a hole in the moon and glazed its edges. Doughmageddon guards the missing center, which it claims is still warm from the oven.

names.legendary: Sol Yolkington, the Breakfast Sun

lore.common: Spreads across the pan until it touches the sausages, then refuses to let go.
lore.uncommon: Slips its yolk into the toast just as someone lifts the slice. Escapes are becoming legendary.
lore.rare: Can light a kitchen with its golden centre, but only until somebody says bacon.
lore.epic: Rose from the frying pan like a second sunrise and convinced the entire town it was Monday again. Everybody went back to work.
lore.legendary: Before the first dawn, Sol Yolkington warmed the darkness in a skillet. The sun still rises every morning to ask for its recipe.

names.legendary: Omelettia, Keeper of the Golden Fold

lore.common: Folds its cheesy middle away whenever someone reaches for the best bite.
lore.uncommon: Waits until the pan is clean, then deposits one final piece of onion in the wrong breakfast.
lore.rare: Can tuck a whole table setting under its golden edges without cracking a single egg.
lore.epic: Leapt from the frying pan and wrapped the entire breakfast brigade in one enormous, fluffy cloak. The head chef surrendered his spatula.
lore.legendary: At the royal feast, Omelettia folded a sunrise into her centre and kept the castle warm all winter. The king still asks for seconds every dawn.

names.legendary: Scrambloria, the Unshackled Egg

lore.common: Sticks to the pan the moment the cook claims to have mastered breakfast.
lore.uncommon: Pretends to be a perfect omelette until somebody lifts a corner and everything falls apart.
lore.rare: Rearranges nearby letters into nonsense when stirred; the morning newspaper now reads like a chicken wrote it.
lore.epic: Sent a wave of golden scrambled eggs across the royal breakfast hall, burying the toast and turning the butter dish into an island.
lore.legendary: Scrambloria broke free of twelve shells at once and has never agreed on which egg she came from. Even the hens bow when she passes, though they whisper about her terrible table manners.

names.legendary: Sir Crispin, the Eternal Golden Fry

lore.common: Wears a golden coat of salt and guards the last chip in the paper cone like a dragon guarding treasure.
lore.uncommon: Has mastered the art of stealing the last chip while everyone watches the seagulls.
lore.rare: Its salty little army marches toward the nearest ketchup bottle. The mayonnaise has hired guards.
lore.epic: The seaside fryer erupted into a golden tornado of chips. Every gull in town formed an air traffic control unit.
lore.legendary: A thousand years after the last fryer cooled, Crispin's golden chip still sizzles. Ancient kings sought it for warmth; one king just wanted vinegar.

names.legendary: Yoghuria, Queen of the Sweet Snow

lore.common: Dresses in sprinkles and melts dramatically whenever somebody compliments its outfit.
lore.uncommon: Sneaks the last chocolate chip into the bottom of the cup and watches everyone look for it.
lore.rare: Freezes a single thought right in someone's head. The professor has been trying to remember Wednesday since July.
lore.epic: Escaped the dessert machine and blanketed the shopping centre in raspberry snow. The security guards made snow angels.
lore.legendary: Yoghuria's palace is built of frozen strawberry clouds. Each summer she sends one sweet blizzard across the desert; the camels ask for sprinkles.

names.legendary: Gelatissimo, Prince of the Endless Scoop

lore.common: Holds three scoops but gives its owner a spoon barely larger than a fingernail. Calls this portion control.
lore.uncommon: Comes with a spoon so small that the gelato melts before the first mouthful is finished.
lore.rare: Changes flavour with the weather. On foggy days it tastes faintly of mystery.
lore.epic: Rolled a mountain of pistachio gelato through the town square. Three hundred tourists followed with tiny plastic spades.
lore.legendary: Gelatissimo once froze the summer heat inside a single cup. When he finally opened it, the whole town got one perfect afternoon of sunshine in December.

names.legendary: Gelatara, the Crown of Endless Scoops

lore.common: Melts down the cone exactly one second before you get a napkin.
lore.uncommon: Leaps off its cone at the first lick and lands with impressive accuracy on clean shoes.
lore.rare: Makes all nearby desserts stay frozen while it quietly steals their sprinkles.
lore.epic: Stacked itself higher than the seaside pier and collapsed in a rainbow avalanche. The town held an emergency waffle-cone festival.
lore.legendary: Gelatara was churned from the first snowfall and a drop of summer sunlight. Every flavour in her crown remembers a season that no longer exists.

names.legendary: Sundaelia, Duchess of the Last Cherry

lore.common: Steals the cherry before anyone gets a spoon.
lore.uncommon: Moves the chocolate sauce to the bottom and laughs at everyone who digs for it.
lore.rare: Balances seven ice cream scoops in defiance of gravity, but collapses dramatically if somebody orders vanilla.
lore.epic: Grew into a frozen tower above the parlour; the fire brigade rescued stranded customers using wafer ladders.
lore.legendary: Sundaelia rules a palace carved from frozen cream, where the cherry on her crown contains the memory of every summer ever tasted.

names.legendary: Wedgewing, Courier of the Midnight Crust

lore.common: Holds a lone slice with its point bent sideways and the cheese stuck to the cardboard.
lore.uncommon: Slips away from the takeaway counter with the only pepperoni slice left.
lore.rare: Warms the last piece of pizza whenever someone offers it to a friend rather than keeping it.
lore.epic: Folded its cardboard wings and launched through the city on a midnight delivery run. The traffic wardens never caught the flying slice.
lore.legendary: Wedgewing delivered the final slice from a vanished pizzeria to its founder's granddaughter fifty years later. The cheese was still warm, and the recipe was tucked beneath the crust.

names.legendary: Popcornelius, Lord of the Last Kernel

lore.common: Pops at the exact moment the scary film goes quiet, terrifying the whole sofa.
lore.uncommon: Drips butter down the cinema seats and claims that is how seats become comfortable.
lore.rare: Hides one unpopped kernel in every handful. Its favourite target is the world's most confident chewer.
lore.epic: Exploded across the cinema in a buttery blizzard, burying the front row up to their noses. The audience demanded a sequel.
lore.legendary: Popcornelius waited for a thousand years as the last stubborn kernel in a forgotten theatre. When it finally burst, the stage lights came on and the lost audience returned for one final performance.

names.legendary: Gyrocles, Hero of the Endless Pita

lore.common: Drips sauce down your sleeve and pretends it has never met a napkin.
lore.uncommon: Smuggles a rogue chip out of the pita and into your shoe.
lore.rare: Spins its filling so quickly that the sauce forms a tiny whirlwind around the lunch table.
lore.epic: Unfurled at the street festival into a pita long enough to wrap the whole parade. The mayor became a garnish.
lore.legendary: Gyrocles once fed an army with a single turning spit, wrapping each warrior's supper in warm bread. His only defeat came when the tzatziki ran out.

names.legendary: Quesaluna, Empress of the Golden Fold

lore.common: Lets the best cheese filling ooze onto somebody else's plate.
lore.uncommon: Steals salsa from every neighbouring dish and blames the tortilla.
lore.rare: Seals its edges so tightly that the cheese inside glows like a miniature volcano.
lore.epic: Unfolded into a golden tortilla large enough to cover the entire restaurant. Every table became a cheese-filled picnic.
lore.legendary: Quesaluna folded the first sunrise between two corn tortillas and served warmth to a mountain village. Her legendary crunch is still heard at dawn.

names.legendary: Shawarmageddon, Endless Feast

lore.common: Steals one crunchy scrap of meat before the wrap is folded and pretends to be lettuce.
lore.uncommon: Drips garlic sauce down a clean sleeve from three metres away.
lore.rare: Hypnotises the takeaway queue with the slow rotation of perfectly crisped meat. The shop closes only when everyone remembers their order.
lore.epic: Spun its towering spit so quickly that the whole street smelled of shawarma. Three neighbouring restaurants surrendered their menus.
lore.legendary: In the oldest bazaar, Shawarmageddon turns on a spit that has never stopped since the first feast. Each revolution feeds another traveller, and the garlic moon rises whenever it is hungry.

names.legendary: Tacozilla, the Folded Moon

lore.common: Cracks in half on the first bite and blames poor handling.
lore.uncommon: Hides extra-hot salsa inside the most innocent-looking lettuce.
lore.rare: Repairs its crispy shell with cheese whenever it breaks, then eats the evidence.
lore.epic: Unfurled its tortilla into a colossal golden crescent across the food festival, trapping a whole marching band in the filling.
lore.legendary: Tacozilla folded a crescent of moonlight around the first midnight feast, keeping its warmth until dawn. The stars still sprinkle themselves on top.

names.legendary: Wrapsody, the Last Unbroken Roll

lore.common: Drops a single piece of cucumber into your lap at the first bite.
lore.uncommon: Untucks one corner whenever its eater is wearing a white shirt.
lore.rare: Can roll itself around a dozen different fillings without letting even a sesame seed escape.
lore.epic: General Foldzilla wrapped the entire lunch queue into one enormous tortilla during the school picnic. The headteacher emerged smelling of hummus and issued a detention to the lettuce.
lore.legendary: Wrapsody was folded by a travelling cook who had forgotten how to return home. Inside its spiralled layers appeared the roads of every country she crossed, including the path to her own kitchen.

names.legendary: Pyrastra, Empress of the Eternal Oven

lore.common: Smells so good that even its own pastry tries to take a bite. Has no idea where the missing corner went.
lore.uncommon: Breathes cinnamon steam when angry. Every argument ends with somebody asking for custard.
lore.rare: Transforms ordinary apples into enchanted pies. The baker has become rich but cannot explain why the apples keep screaming about their destiny.
lore.epic: Unleashed a rolling wave of bubbling apple filling across the village square. The annual bake-off was declared a natural disaster and a huge success.
lore.legendary: Pyrastra baked the first apple pie in the fire of a falling star. Its lattice crust contains the pattern of the constellations, and every slice shows the eater a different future.

names.legendary: Bao Long, the Cloud Dumpling

lore.common: A steamed little puff that sighs whenever somebody opens its basket too soon.
lore.uncommon: Steals the softest pillow in the house and insists the resemblance is entirely coincidental.
lore.rare: Springs out of the steamer with enough bounce to knock the restaurant sign straight.
lore.epic: Rose so high during dinner that the whole restaurant floated above the city. Diners called the view excellent and the service unusually airborne.
lore.legendary: The first heavenly dumpling was steamed in a dragon's breath. Bao Long still feeds lost travellers from a kitchen hidden among the clouds.

names.legendary: Duchess Shortbread, Last Crumb Guardian

lore.common: Rattles convincingly even when only three stale crumbs remain. It enjoys false hope.
lore.uncommon: Disguises sewing needles as biscuits. Grandchildren have learned to fear decorative tins.
lore.rare: Swaps its contents between cookies and sewing supplies whenever a different generation opens the lid.
lore.epic: Escaped the pantry with an army of shortbread soldiers. The kitchen was besieged until someone offered tea.
lore.legendary: Her iron lid has defied giants, locksmiths and the strongest man alive. Grandma opens it with a teaspoon and calls everyone dramatic.

names.legendary: Butterragnar, the Golden Slip Lord

lore.common: Leaps off warm toast before you can take a bite. Nobody has successfully caught it.
lore.uncommon: Pretends to be a brick every morning, then dissolves the moment you turn away.
lore.rare: Slides between slices of bread and steals the filling. The sandwich blames its own poor choices.
lore.epic: Coated the palace staircase in golden butter. The king reached the bottom before his own trousers and abolished stairs.
lore.legendary: Legends say its touch makes anything irresistibly smooth. A knight once polished his armour with it and slid clean out of the history books.

names.legendary: Calzoran, Keeper of the Hidden Feast

lore.common: Looks like an innocent bread roll until the first bite releases three litres of steam.
lore.uncommon: Hides all the best fillings at one end and leaves you chewing bread for the first half.
lore.rare: Produces a completely different pizza every time it is sliced. The restaurant has stopped taking orders.
lore.epic: Burst open during the grand feast and flooded the ballroom with rivers of mozzarella. Guests escaped on floating breadsticks.
lore.legendary: The first Calzoran was folded by a giant who wished to hide an entire banquet from the gods. To this day its crust conceals a restaurant with no closing time.

names.legendary: Flossandra, Weaver of Edible Skies

lore.common: Looks as big as your head and disappears in three bites. It calls this a magic trick.
lore.uncommon: Attaches itself to hair, sleeves and passing strangers. The stick is merely a suggestion.
lore.rare: Spins sugar from thin air into intricate webs. The dentist has asked it to stop reproducing.
lore.epic: Wrapped an entire fairground in a pink sugar cloud. The Ferris wheel emerged wearing a magnificent candy beard.
lore.legendary: Flossandra spins the clouds that make children dream of summer fairs. When it rains pink sugar, the gods know she has been skipping her chores.

names.legendary: Gorgonzar, Sovereign of the Living Rind

lore.common: Moves closer to the milk every night. The milk has asked to change shelves.
lore.uncommon: Insists its blue veins are an expensive marble finish. The fridge disagrees.
lore.rare: Ages fifty years whenever the fridge opens. Grandad has started asking it for pension advice.
lore.epic: Unwrapped itself on an overnight train. The passengers fled to the roof, and the conductor gave it a first-class compartment.
lore.legendary: Gorgonzar's legendary rind is said to smell through solid stone. The harbour uses it as a foghorn; the ships steer by nose.

names.legendary: Count Holebrecht, the Hollow Monarch

lore.common: Wears its point like a knight's helmet. Falls over every time it bows.
lore.uncommon: Moves its holes around at night. One morning the holes were arranged to spell PAY RENT.
lore.rare: Lets mice enter its tunnels but charges them in crumbs. The resident committee is furious.
lore.epic: Its enormous holes swallowed the banquet orchestra one instrument at a time. The tuba has been playing from underground ever since.
lore.legendary: Count Holebrecht rules a labyrinth of cheese tunnels beneath the Alps. Adventurers who emerge are richer in wisdom and considerably shorter on lactose tolerance.

names.legendary: Velvetta, Duchess of the Final Slice

lore.common: Steals the crunchy biscuit base from beneath itself. Then looks shocked when it topples.
lore.uncommon: Pretends to be light and delicate until the fork needs a forklift.
lore.rare: Makes whoever takes the last slice confess their deepest dessert-related crime.
lore.epic: Slid down the palace staircase in a creamy avalanche and buried the royal guards in raspberry topping. They requested seconds.
lore.legendary: Velvetta's filling is so rich that kingdoms have offered their treasuries for one forkful. She refuses payment, demanding instead the family recipe for a good biscuit base.

names.legendary: Madame Pralina, Queen of the Final Piece

lore.common: Offers fifteen identical chocolates and somehow makes picking one feel like a job interview.
lore.uncommon: Replaces every caramel with orange cream when nobody looks. The family has named it as the suspect.
lore.rare: Rearranges its little flavour map so every choice becomes a surprise. Some surprises are raisins.
lore.epic: Called the entire royal court to choose the last truffle. The debate lasted six weeks and ended in a chocolate referendum.
lore.legendary: Madame Pralina's box never empties, but every chocolate reveals something you weren't supposed to know. The king ate a hazelnut and immediately abdicated.

names.legendary: Churromancer, Master of Endless Cinnamon

lore.common: Coats its owner's sleeve in sugar before the first bite. Calls this a blessing.
lore.uncommon: Hides the crunchy end until the chocolate dip is empty.
lore.rare: Grows longer with every dunk. The chocolate pot is now dangerously deep.
lore.epic: Uncoiled across the fairground and wrapped the Ferris wheel in cinnamon. Passengers ate their way back to earth.
lore.legendary: Churromancer spins fried golden spirals from the scent of midnight festivals. One was so long that it became a new road, with a tollbooth made of chocolate.

names.legendary: Cinnabaron, Lord of the Thousand Layers

lore.common: Unravels its own outer ring when someone takes a bite. Claims this is striptease.
lore.uncommon: Drips icing precisely onto important paperwork. The office now smells excellent.
lore.rare: Spins its cinnamon spiral fast enough to hypnotise anyone within smelling distance. The baker has missed lunch for six days.
lore.epic: Rolled down the palace banquet table and swallowed every pastry in its path. Returned as a golden spiral the size of a carriage.
lore.legendary: Cinnabaron coils around the first oven ever built, guarding a recipe that can make a whole kingdom forgive its enemies. He refuses to share it without extra frosting.

names.legendary: Saccharina, Pink Storm of the Sea

lore.common: Melts into a sticky pink tear whenever it hears the word rain.
lore.uncommon: Wraps itself around children's fingers and demands to be carried.
lore.rare: Floats off the stick and convinces passing clouds to become edible.
lore.epic: Swallowed an entire circus in a pink sugar cyclone. The acrobats emerged with impressive hair and very sticky shoes.
lore.legendary: Once crossed the ocean disguised as a sunset cloud. Entire ships chased its sweetness; their captains now insist the horizon tastes of strawberries.

names.legendary: Profiterax, Herald of the Cream Moon

lore.common: Explodes into whipped cream the instant someone wears a nice shirt.
lore.uncommon: Puffs itself twice its size during judging, then collapses when the chef looks away.
lore.rare: Escapes every pastry display by disguising itself as a perfectly innocent bread roll.
lore.epic: Launched a thousand cream-filled cannonballs across the royal banquet. The portraits looked younger by dessert.
lore.legendary: Each century Profiterax ascends above the bakery as a pale sweet moon. Its eclipses are celebrated with spoons, and meteorologists refuse to taste the forecast.

names.legendary: Crepella, Weaver of Edible Horizons

lore.common: Wraps itself round lemon and sugar like a tiny striped sleeping bag.
lore.uncommon: Tears elegantly down the middle the moment someone admires its shape.
lore.rare: Folds into swans, hats and slightly judgmental portraits of the cook.
lore.epic: Escaped the griddle and wrapped the entire market square like a theatrical curtain. The crowd demanded an encore and syrup.
lore.legendary: Wove the first flying carpet from pastry so thin the moon shone through it. Royal sorcerers pursued her for centuries, armed only with forks.

names.legendary: Custardor, Lord of the Endless Spoon

lore.common: Forms a skin the second someone looks away.
lore.uncommon: Hides a single suspicious lump at the bottom of every bowl.
lore.rare: Rises to answer the question, What's for dessert, regardless of what dinner was.
lore.epic: Engulfed the school dining hall in a golden wave. The headteacher declared an emergency, then asked for apple crumble.
lore.legendary: Flowed from the first enchanted pudding bowl and has never stopped. An ancient prophecy promises it will cover the kingdom; most people are making room for seconds.

names.legendary: Viennois, Duke of the Golden Labyrinth

lore.common: Leaves a single cherry stain on every official document.
lore.uncommon: Guards its jam centre like a dragon guards treasure, only stickier.
lore.rare: Rearranges its pastry layers while being eaten. Nobody has ever found the middle.
lore.epic: Unfolded across the banquet table into a maze of pastry and icing. The king wandered for hours and emerged with three second helpings.
lore.legendary: Was baked with so many golden layers that the dawn sun got lost between them. The royal astronomer now checks the bakery before announcing sunrise.

names.legendary: The Thousand-Fold Dumpling Dragon

lore.common: Sits in its steamer basket and pretends the lid is a penthouse roof.
lore.uncommon: Steals one dumpling from every shared plate, then blames the chopsticks.
lore.rare: Rolls through the restaurant disguised as an innocent bamboo basket. Nobody notices until the bill starts rolling too.
lore.epic: Rose from a tower of steaming baskets and demanded tribute in chilli oil. The entire banquet bowed, except one brave spring roll.
lore.legendary: Its pleats are said to contain a thousand secret recipes. Once each century it opens its mouth and serves a feast to ghosts who have forgotten how to eat.

names.legendary: Donutella, Keeper of the Thirteenth

lore.common: Smells wonderful until opened. Contains exactly one empty wrapper.
lore.uncommon: Locks itself when anyone claims they will only have half a doughnut.
lore.rare: Makes its contents invisible to anyone who has already eaten three. Doctors are baffled; children are delighted.
lore.epic: Started an office rebellion when it replaced the last twelve doughnuts with twelve identical apology notes. HR called it a culture initiative.
lore.legendary: Every dozen in Donutella's care gains a mysterious thirteenth ring. It appears only to the person who gives the last treat to somebody else.

names.legendary: Baozar, Keeper of the Sealed Feast

lore.common: Looks innocent until bitten. The filling has other plans.
lore.uncommon: Escapes chopsticks by rolling under the nearest bowl.
lore.rare: Contains so much hot broth that brave diners approach it with a spoon and a written will.
lore.epic: Rose from a bamboo steamer the size of a pavilion and demanded the entire banquet's soy sauce. The emperor surrendered his finest porcelain.
lore.legendary: Baozar has kept the secret filling of the first dumpling sealed for centuries. Every chef who tastes it forgets their own recipe and starts again from scratch.

names.legendary: Eclairion, Lightning in Chocolate

lore.common: Looks elegant until the first bite. Then all the cream escapes.
lore.uncommon: Throws its chocolate topping at anyone who calls it a long doughnut.
lore.rare: Regrows a fresh layer of ganache each midnight. The baker guards it with a spoon.
lore.epic: Launched a cream-filled lightning strike across the royal bakery, coating the judges in chocolate. They unanimously awarded it first place.
lore.legendary: Eclairion was born when a thunderbolt struck a pastry oven. Each century its chocolate glaze flashes with lightning and grants a baker one perfect dessert.

names.legendary: Empanador, the Golden Crescent

lore.common: Keeps its spicy filling secret, including from the person eating it.
lore.uncommon: Has a hundred crimps along its edge. Every one is a tiny escape hatch for gravy.
lore.rare: Closes its pastry jaws around the fork of anyone who says they prefer sandwiches.
lore.epic: Stormed the town baking contest with an army of golden pastry knights. The judges surrendered after the first bite.
lore.legendary: Legend says Empanador holds an entire lost kingdom between its folded edges. The royal family is still inside arguing over whether raisins belong in the filling.

names.legendary: Enchillord of the Molten Mesa

lore.common: Wears a blanket of melted cheese and refuses to get out of bed.
lore.uncommon: Rolls away from the fork just far enough to paint the tablecloth red.
lore.rare: Haunts empty plates, leaving only mysterious chilli footprints in the sour cream.
lore.epic: Flooded the village fiesta in red sauce and floated down the street in a tortilla boat. The mariachi band kept playing on the roof.
lore.legendary: An ancient enchilada coils beneath a volcanic mesa, guarding the world's first chilli. Whenever it turns in its sleep, every restaurant changes its spice rating.

names.legendary: The Chickpea Colossus of the Bazaar

lore.common: Rolls out of the pita the moment its owner looks away.
lore.uncommon: Steals sauce from every nearby plate and calls it a diplomatic exchange.
lore.rare: Can bounce across a market without losing a single cumin seed. The vendor's dog has given up chasing it.
lore.epic: Raised an army of crispy chickpea spheres that rolled through the bazaar, flattening a thousand kebab queues. The hummus stand surrendered without a fight.
lore.legendary: Beneath the ancient bazaar sleeps a giant falafel said to contain the first chickpea. Once a century it awakens to ask for tahini and judges the kingdom's seasoning.

names.legendary: Mapelord, Guardian of the Golden Slice

lore.common: Wakes up in an egg bath and demands a cinnamon blanket before agreeing to be breakfast.
lore.uncommon: Absorbs so much syrup that it squeaks when squeezed. Its pancakes are getting jealous.
lore.rare: Can soak up an entire breakfast drink without becoming soggy. The tea pot has started hiding.
lore.epic: One golden slice expanded until it covered the entire breakfast buffet. The toast rack resigned on principle.
lore.legendary: The Golden Slice was fried in the first sunrise and sprinkled with cinnamon from a dragon's breath. Its syrup remembers every tree it came from.

names.legendary: Garlicko, the Undead's Landlord

lore.common: Announces dinner to the entire neighbourhood with one powerful breath of toasted garlic.
lore.uncommon: Makes every room smell delicious except the one where the person who hates garlic is sitting.
lore.rare: One bite gives its eater a breath so powerful that doors swing open when they speak.
lore.epic: At the midnight feast, an army of vampires arrived. One whiff of the garlic toast sent them fleeing with their capes over their noses.
lore.legendary: Legend says Garlicko feeds the castle's ghosts every full moon. They cannot eat the bread, but the smell keeps all the vampires out.

names.legendary: Gnocchimus, the Cloud Dumpling King

lore.common: Floats to the top of the saucepan like a tiny potato pillow demanding to be rescued.
lore.uncommon: Pretends to be a tiny pillow until someone tries to sleep on it. Smells strongly of potato.
lore.rare: Leaps from boiling water exactly when ready, then demands applause from the saucepan.
lore.epic: Multiplied in the pot until every family in the village had dinner. The original cook is still looking for a lid large enough.
lore.legendary: Gnocchimus was rolled from a cloud and cooked in the first rain. His dumplings are so light they float to the table, where the hungry must catch them with butterfly nets.

names.legendary: Wigglesworth, Keeper of the Last Bounce

lore.common: Trembles at the sight of a spoon, even when the spoon is in another room.
lore.uncommon: Slides off the plate and leaves a perfectly rectangular wobble print behind.
lore.rare: Pulses to any nearby music, although it is hopeless at keeping time with Dad's singing.
lore.epic: Bounced right out of the town talent contest and performed an encore on the mayor's bald head. The audience demanded more jelly.
lore.legendary: Wigglesworth was once tapped by the great clockmaker and has never stopped wobbling. The town's clocks now swing in time with its shimmering sides.

names.legendary: Mount Wobblemore, the Edible Mountain

lore.common: Slides out of its mould with a proud wobble, then promptly falls sideways.
lore.uncommon: Comes out shaped like a rabbit but loses one ear before the guests arrive.
lore.rare: Changes shape every time the plate is turned. The fish-shaped dessert has escaped into the sink.
lore.epic: Rose into an enormous jelly castle during the birthday feast. The toy knights declared war on the custard before the walls collapsed.
lore.legendary: Mount Wobblemore rises only at the midsummer banquet, a great trembling hill of sweet jelly. Pilgrims bring spoons and leave with sticky boots and heroic stories.

names.legendary: Saint Mallow, the Kindly White Inferno

lore.common: Gets stuck to the wrapper and drags it along like a cape.
lore.uncommon: Browns beautifully over the fire, then turns the cook's fingers into sticky mittens.
lore.rare: Expands into a fluffy pillow whenever it hears someone say 'just one more'.
lore.epic: Grew across the entire campsite into a soft white mountain. The scouts spent the night tunnelling out with chocolate biscuits.
lore.legendary: Saint Mallow rose from the last ember of a winter bonfire to warm a camp of lost travellers. By morning the forest lay beneath a sweet, white blanket that never burned.

names.legendary: Mousseline, Duchess of the Airy Feast

lore.common: Quivers on the spoon as though it knows the terrible fate awaiting chocolate desserts.
lore.uncommon: Melts into a little puddle if the party spends too long taking photos.
lore.rare: Turns every conversation at the table into an absurdly formal whisper. Even toddlers request the dessert menu.
lore.epic: Floated off the banquet table and drifted through the ballroom in a cloud of cocoa. Guests applauded, then chased it with spoons.
lore.legendary: Mousseline whipped the fog of a chocolate kingdom into a single perfect dessert. Its sweet scent still returns to the castle whenever the clouds pass low.

names.legendary: Topsworth, Emperor of the Muffin Crown

lore.common: Lives on the top of the muffin and openly considers the bottom an unnecessary accessory.
lore.uncommon: Breaks away during breakfast, leaving the rest of the cake feeling abandoned.
lore.rare: Expands over every neighbouring muffin until the whole tray becomes one gigantic crispy roof.
lore.epic: Escaped the bakery with all the muffin crowns and built a crunchy palace. The abandoned bottoms organised a protest march.
lore.legendary: Topsworth stole the golden crowns from a thousand birthday muffins and shaped them into one glorious throne. Every crumb beneath it still dreams of royalty.

names.legendary: Nachomanjaro, Crown of the Guac Gods

lore.common: Hides the cheesiest chip at the bottom of the pile, just beyond the reach of the hungry guest.
lore.uncommon: Dives into the salsa and returns wearing a little red cape.
lore.rare: Spins melted cheese into strands so strong that lifting one tortilla brings the whole platter along.
lore.epic: Erupted during movie night, burying the sofa under a lava flow of melted cheese and tortilla triangles. The family voted to stay and eat their way out.
lore.legendary: Nachomanjaro rose from the first mountain of golden corn chips, crowned in guacamole clouds. Pilgrims climb its crispy slopes searching for the legendary last loaded chip.

names.legendary: Sir Griddleton, Lord of the Golden Peak

lore.common: Leans sideways every time a new pancake is added, blaming the plate.
lore.uncommon: Slides its top pancake away when the smallest child reaches for it.
lore.rare: Can hold a whole jar of syrup between its layers without dripping a drop.
lore.epic: Rose so tall during the village breakfast that clouds gathered around the top. The cook sent a mountaineer up with the last butter pat.
lore.legendary: Sir Griddleton built his golden tower to feed a winter-stricken valley. Each pancake returned at dawn, leaving the villagers with breakfast and a very sticky pilgrimage route.

names.legendary: Lady Millefeuille of the Sky Bakery

lore.common: Drops buttery crumbs on the carpet before anyone has taken the first bite.
lore.uncommon: Puffs up in the oven until the filling needs to knock before coming out.
lore.rare: Wraps around anything it touches, turning teacups and spoons into suspiciously delicious parcels.
lore.epic: Swelled so fiercely at the bakery that the roof lifted like a giant flaky lid. The baker sold tickets to the view.
lore.legendary: Lady Millefeuille baked a thousand golden layers into a single pastry to shelter a village from a winter storm. When spring came, everyone ate the roof together.

names.legendary: Sliciana, Heir to the Neverending Pie

lore.common: Lets the best bit of filling slide onto the plate just before the first bite.
lore.uncommon: Grows slightly larger when someone says they only want a small piece.
lore.rare: Regrows into a complete pie when left alone overnight. The baker has started charging for babysitting.
lore.epic: Divided itself among an entire wedding party, giving every guest the biggest slice. The pie dish filed for extra space.
lore.legendary: Sliciana was the last slice served at the feast of a forgotten queen. No matter how many hungry travellers share it, another warm wedge appears beneath the golden crust.

names.legendary: Puddington, King of the Last Spoonful

lore.common: Trembles on the plate whenever someone mentions vegetables.
lore.uncommon: Steals the final spoon of custard while everyone is arguing over who deserves it.
lore.rare: Makes every diner forget the main course and demand dessert first. Even the chef joins in.
lore.epic: Wobbled so fiercely at the banquet that every table danced the same jelly jig. The orchestra could not keep up.
lore.legendary: Puddington sat on the royal dessert throne for a century, deciding who deserved the last spoonful. Nobody ever qualified, so he ate it himself.

names.legendary: Ravioluna, Oracle of a Thousand Secrets

lore.common: Loses its filling in boiling water and calls it a daring escape.
lore.uncommon: Hides one mysterious extra-cheesy pocket in every bowl.
lore.rare: Folds itself around stolen ingredients and vanishes into a pot of boiling water.
lore.epic: Opened a thousand pasta pockets at the banquet, releasing tiny cheese dragons that demanded grated parmesan.
lore.legendary: Ravioluna stores the forgotten recipes of a hundred grandmothers inside her golden folds. Each bite reveals one memory, usually accompanied by excessive garlic.

names.legendary: Samozaar, Keeper of the Threefold Spice

lore.common: Scatters pastry flakes over a freshly swept carpet the moment anybody picks it up.
lore.uncommon: Hides one fiercely spicy pea beneath a perfectly innocent golden crust.
lore.rare: Splits into three crisp triangles when cornered, each with a different fiery filling.
lore.epic: Built a giant pyramid of samosas at the royal feast. By dessert the guests had eaten the staircase and nobody could reach the top.
lore.legendary: Samozaar forged the first golden triangle around a jewel of spiced potato. When its three corners meet at midnight, the entire palace smells of cumin and victory.

names.legendary: Sausagor, the Endless Golden Coil

lore.common: Has the temperature of the sun inside and the temperature of the kitchen floor outside.
lore.uncommon: Scatters crumbs across the bus seat like evidence from a very tasty crime scene.
lore.rare: Slips out of the bakery before opening time and returns smelling of mustard and trouble.
lore.epic: Stretched all the way around the village fete, turning the fun run into a competitive sausage-roll eating event.
lore.legendary: Sausagor sleeps in the ovens beneath the oldest bakery. When he awakens, the scent of golden pastry travels a hundred miles and every hungry traveller knows the road home.

names.legendary: Lady Sconewell, Keeper of Jam and Cream

lore.common: Crumbles into a thousand pieces as soon as the teapot arrives.
lore.uncommon: Puts the cream underneath the jam when visiting Cornwall, and on top when visiting Devon, just to start arguments.
lore.rare: Splits perfectly in two without a knife, but only for guests who pronounce its name the opposite way.
lore.epic: Started such a fierce jam-versus-cream debate at the county fair that the judges built a hedge between the two sides.
lore.legendary: Lady Sconewell held a tea party where every guest received the perfect scone their own way. For one glorious afternoon, Devon and Cornwall agreed on everything except the pronunciation.

names.legendary: Springrollius, the First Crunch

lore.common: Explodes a cloud of pastry flakes onto your shirt at the first bite.
lore.uncommon: Dives into sweet chilli sauce so deep that the spoon must come to its rescue.
lore.rare: Unrolls itself into a ribbon of crisp golden pastry and ties the chef's shoelaces together.
lore.epic: Uncoiled across the banquet hall like a golden dragon, crunching so loudly that the royal orchestra lost its place.
lore.legendary: Springrollius guards the first perfect crunch inside a thousand layers of pastry. Once a year it releases the sound, and every hungry person turns toward the kitchen.

names.legendary: Tlamina, Warmth Beneath the Husk

lore.common: Refuses to leave its corn husk until everybody at the table is watching.
lore.uncommon: Wraps itself in two extra husks to avoid sharing the filling.
lore.rare: Keeps its heart of steaming masa warm all night and whispers secrets through the leaf wrapping.
lore.epic: Unrolled its endless husk across the banquet hall and trapped all the guests in an enormous edible corn maze.
lore.legendary: Tlamina taught the first family to fold their harvest into little parcels, preserving the warmth of home through a year of wandering. Her husks still rustle with their songs.

names.legendary: Tartalune, the Orchard's Golden Crown

lore.common: Rolls its fruit garnish off the plate and watches everyone blame the waiter.
lore.uncommon: Polishes its glazed berries until the bakery window looks like a jeweller's display.
lore.rare: Turns its polished fruit into little ruby shields that guard the last slice from hungry hands.
lore.epic: Glimmered so magnificently that a magpie army carried the entire pastry display to the bell tower, where it established a bakery.
lore.legendary: Tartalune was baked with the first fruits of a garden that grew beneath the stars. Each jewel-bright slice carries one forgotten season back to the table.

names.legendary: Tiramisura, the Dessert That Raised Dawn

lore.common: Dusts cocoa over its own nose, then sneezes directly onto your clean shirt.
lore.uncommon: Hides an extra spoonful of mascarpone in every layer and denies everything.
lore.rare: Wakes sleepy dinner guests with one enchanted coffee-soaked bite, then sends them dancing round the table.
lore.epic: Rose from the dessert trolley as a towering cream-and-coffee colossus and kept the entire opera awake for three encores.
lore.legendary: Tiramisura appeared at the end of a winter feast when the sun refused to rise. Its bittersweet perfume lured dawn back over the hills, and nobody has ever shared the final slice.

names.legendary: Crispus, Defier of the Buttered Fall

lore.common: Flings crumbs into your pyjamas and calls it breakfast confetti.
lore.uncommon: Hops off the plate whenever anyone reaches for the jam.
lore.rare: Regrows every crust a child cuts away, then forms them into tiny crunchy legs.
lore.epic: Leapt from a hundred toasters at sunrise and sailed over the city on a cloud of cinnamon smoke. The pigeons declared a public holiday.
lore.legendary: Crispus is the only toast ever to land butter-side up after a fall from the moon. Gravity denies the incident, but the legendary golden smear still glows across the night sky.

names.legendary: Quadrilla, the Feast of Forty Squares

lore.common: Keeps one secret syrup puddle in the corner of its grid.
lore.uncommon: Steals toppings from neighbouring breakfasts when nobody is watching.
lore.rare: Arranges a different filling in every square, including one deeply unpopular broccoli cube.
lore.epic: Stacked itself into a waffle tower so high that the children used its squares as climbing grips to rescue the jam.
lore.legendary: Hosted a festival on its endless golden squares. Each traveller found their favourite breakfast waiting in one cell, even those who swore they didn't like waffles.

names.legendary: Lactella, the Million Tiny Guests

lore.common: Clings to the foil lid and drops a white blob on every fresh jumper.
lore.uncommon: Swaps its fruit layer from bottom to top while nobody is looking.
lore.rare: Commands its microscopic cultures to turn a bowl of milk into a perfectly set dessert before breakfast.
lore.epic: Baroness Curdquake launched a strawberry eruption from one lunchbox, coating an entire school bus in pink. The driver declared it a mobile dessert parlour.
lore.legendary: Lactella invited a million invisible guests to a single pot and fed them one spoonful of milk. By sunrise they had made a feast for the whole village, without leaving a single dirty plate.
